paper_metadata.title: Effect of Ge addition on the microstructure, mechanical properties, and corrosion behavior of CoCrFeNi high-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: in this study, Ge is included in CoCrFeNi alloys to form CoCrFeNiGe x alloys (molar ratio, x = 0, 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3).
a series of CoCrFeNiGe x (x = 0, 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3) alloys were fabricated for analysis of various trends.
a series of CoCrFeNiGe x (x = 0, 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3) alloys were fabricated for analysis of various trends.
a series of CoCrFeNiGe x (x = 0, 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3) alloys were fabricated for analysis of various trends.

CoCrFeNiGe x alloys were vacuum arc-melted from pure elements with purities above 99.9 wt%. Round ingots with a weight of approximately 70 g were re-melted at least four times to ensure sufficient mixing.
All ingots were homogenized for 24 h in a furnace at a temperature of 1000 ◦ C, followed by quenching in water.
